# Commands

Pragma is two screens, and each has its own short list. A command starts with `/`; anything else typed inside a project is said to the agent.

Read from [`terminal/pragma_home.py`](../../terminal/pragma_home.py), [`agent/chat.py`](../../agent/chat.py) and [`terminal/pragma_configure.py`](../../terminal/pragma_configure.py).

## At home

Where no project is open: what is done *to* a project lives here.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/open` | go into a project - /open &lt;name&gt;, tab completes it |
| `/new` | start a project |
| `/projects` | everything done to a project: `open`, `new`, `backups`, `delete` |
| `/jobs` | what the memory is writing in the background: follow it, stop it, run it again |
| `/serve` | projects other programs can talk to, as to a model |
| `/configure` | the model server Pragma talks to |
| `/clear` | draw this page again, as things are now (ctrl+L) |
| `/help` | this list |
| `/exit` | leave |

### `/projects`

Alone it opens the page; followed by one of these it goes straight there.

| Action | What it does |
|---|---|
| `open` | open a project and start talking; /projects open &lt;name&gt; goes straight in |
| `new` | start a project |
| `backups` | snapshot a project's memory, or put one back |
| `delete` | remove a project, and the memory it keeps |

## Inside a project

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/memory` | look at the store: `map`, `beliefs`, `last`, `diff`, `dormant`, `sizes`, `vectors` |
| `/settings` | how many steps a turn may take, and how much the memory brings to one |
| `/status` | how this project is set up right now |
| `/plan` | what the advisor said in the last turn, in full |
| `/jobs` | what the memory is writing in the background: follow it, stop it, run it again |
| `/configure` | point Pragma at an LLM endpoint |
| `/compact` | summarise the conversation so far and go on from the summary |
| `/clear` | start over with an empty context; what was said goes to the memory |
| `/help` | this list |

### `/memory`

Alone it shows `map`.

| View | What it shows |
|---|---|
| `map` | what is remembered, strongest first |
| `beliefs` | what it has concluded from it |
| `last` | the newest episode, in full |
| `diff` | meanings it has revised |
| `dormant` | what has faded out of use |
| `sizes` | how much of it can reach a prompt |
| `vectors` | what it is searched by when there is an embedding server; `rebuild` computes it again |

### Commands that live at home

These belong to the home screen. Typed inside a project they say where they went instead of failing.

| Command | At home it is |
|---|---|
| `/backups` | snapshot or restore |
| `/switch` | another project |
| `/new` | start a project |
| `/delete` | remove a project |
| `/open` | open a project |
| `/projects` | the projects screen itself |

## `/configure`

Reached from either screen. A page walked with the arrows rather than typed.

One rule on every row: ↑↓ chooses it, ←→ changes its value where it has one, Enter opens what is a list or has to be typed.

The page is a table of who does what - one row for each of the 5 roles, with its model and how it thinks there - and two rows under it, `servers` and `this machine`.

| Role | What it does |
|---|---|
| `agent` | does the work |
| `recall` | picks what to remember, before each turn |
| `memory` | writes what happened, afterwards |
| `critic` | checks the work, where a project wants it |
| `advisor` | plans the turn, where a project wants it |

On a role, ←→ changes how it thinks: `reasons` or `at once` on a model that can reason, the effort from `low` to `max` on Claude through Anthropic's API. Enter chooses its model from the servers that are up; any role but the agent's can be the same as the agent's.

`servers` lists those that are up, then `add a server`, then those that are down. Enter on one opens its page, where every row is one question about the machine:

| Row | What it is |
|---|---|
| `what it is` | a reasoning model, or one that answers at once |
| `what it is for` | conversation, or writing code |
| `sampling` | the knobs every request carries |
| `name` | what these pages call it |
| `address` | where the server listens |
| `model` | which one, where a server hosts several |
| `API key` | typed, or left in an environment variable |
| `remove` | take it off the list |

On Anthropic's API `what it is`, `what it is for` and `sampling` are not asked.

`this machine` holds the switches that are the whole machine's:

| Choice | What it is |
|---|---|
| `prediction` | on or off: the line you will probably type next, in grey; tab takes it |
| `meaning` | the memory searched by meaning, with an embedding server |
| `mcp` | servers whose tools the agent is offered |

## Keys

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| ctrl+D | At the prompt of a project: close it and hand the conversation to the memory. While a turn is running: stop the turn, as ctrl+C does - the project stays open. At home: leave. In a menu or a page: go back. |
| ctrl+C | Stop the turn that is running; the project stays open. Pressed again, abandon it at once. In a menu: go back. |
| tab, or right arrow | Take the suggested next line, when one is shown. |
| tab | After a `/`: complete the command. |
| arrows, a digit, a first letter | Move in a menu. Enter selects. |
| ctrl+Enter, or alt+Enter | At the prompt of a project: a new line in the message; Enter sends the whole of it. A terminal that sends ctrl+Enter as plain Enter leaves alt+Enter. |
| arrows, ctrl+arrows, home, end | Move along the line in anything you type - the prompts, a name, an address, a y/n. |

Offered by no list, and still working: a habit is not worth breaking.

|---|---|---|

| `/quit` | `/exit` | at home |
| `/?` | `/help` | at home |
| `/project` | `/projects` | at home |
| `/o` | `/open` | at home |
| `/n` | `/new` | at home |
| `/backups` | `/projects backups` | at home |
| `/delete` | `/projects delete` | at home |
| `/info` | `/help` | in a project |
| `/map` | `/memory map` | in a project |
| `/beliefs` | `/memory beliefs` | in a project |
| `/last` | `/memory last` | in a project |
| `/diff` | `/memory diff` | in a project |
| `/dormant` | `/memory dormant` | in a project |
| `/sizes` | `/memory sizes` | in a project |
| `/vectors` | `/memory vectors` | in a project |
| `/oblio` | `/memory dormant` | in a project |
| `/project` | `/settings` | in a project |
| `/config` | `/configure` | in a project |
| `/close` | `/exit` | in a project |
